spans.s: टिटिभक टिटिभक, अस्, m. a bird, = टिट्टिभ.
टिट्टिभक, अस्, m. the bird Parra Jacana or Gœnsis.

टिटिल टिटिल, अम्, n. a large number, =
100 Nāga-balas.

टिट्टिभ टिट्टिभ, अस्, m. a kind of bird, Parra
Jacana or Gœnsis; N. of a Daitya; also of a Dānava
who was an enemy of Indra in the thirteenth Manv-
antara; (ई), f. the female of the bird Parra Jacana.
